summary: tiktok sessions keep tiktok on screen so likes, follows and comments work
changes: a tiktok session now brings the tiktok tab to the front when it starts. tiktok only loads a post's like, follow and comment buttons, and more search results, while its tab is on screen.
if the tiktok tab goes to the background, the session pauses and says so, then carries on when tiktok is back on screen.
each opened tiktok post gets a few seconds for its like, follow and comment panel to load before the session decides what to do.
the double-check that a tiktok like or follow stuck now waits up to 20 seconds for tiktok to load, so real likes and follows stop showing as not confirmed.
replace the files in your original extension folder, reload the extension and reopen warm-up.
